examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}のセールが{始|はじ}まった。
セール{中|ちゅう}は{店|みせ}が{混雑|こんざつ}する。
examples.english: The store gets crowded during sales.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}{年始|ねんし}のセールでお{得|とく}な{商品|しょうひん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought bargain items during the year-end and New Year sale.

notes:
セール is a loanword from English "sale," referring to discount sales or promotional events.

Common expressions:
- セール{中|ちゅう} (on sale, during the sale)
- セールを{行|おこな}う (to hold a sale)
- {夏|なつ}のセール / {冬|ふゆ}のセール (summer/winter sale)
- タイムセール (time-limited sale)
- {閉店|へいてん}セール (closing sale)
- {決算|けっさん}セール (end-of-fiscal-year sale)

Note: In Japanese, セール specifically means a discount sale, not the general act of selling (which is {販売|はんばい}).

Related terms:
- バーゲン (bargain sale)
- {安売|やすう}り (selling at a discount)
- {特売|とくばい} (special sale)
